claim_sentence_ko: 한국 플랫폼들은 모든 분야에서 강하게 역차별을 받고 있음
evidence_summary: Baseline and several robustness tests keep all three required sectors positive in Korea-market signed direction, but the strong line fails every robustness scenario because direct evidence rows remain `5 < 6`, webtoon/story is still thin, and mixed-sign infra rows survive.
main_failure_or_risk: `모든 분야에서 강하게` is too strong for the current pack: webtoon/story is not headline-safe and infra contains true negative direct cells plus mixed-sign rows.

claim_sentence_ko: 한국 규제기관은 실질적으로 해외 플랫폼을 규제하지 못하고 있음
evidence_summary: The current Korean-market record repeatedly shows uneven same-service reach, observability, and enforceability against foreign peers in music and digital infra, especially at the service-country burden-capture level.
main_failure_or_risk: The strong wording overstates total incapacity because formal foreign reach clearly exists through PIPA, VAT, app-market enforcement, and similar channels.

claim_sentence_ko: 한국 규제기관은 국내 creators / artists 보호에는 적극적이나 이게 오히려 국내 플랫폼에 불리함으로 작용
evidence_summary: Music provides direct domestic burden-incidence evidence through public tariff, gross-sales-base, discount-inclusion, and same-service settlement rules, and webtoon/story provides weaker but directionally similar creator-side burden objects.
main_failure_or_risk: Foreign same-service creator-incidence remains thin or not publicly observable, so the comparative causal reading still rests partly on bounded inference rather than matched foreign burden observation.

claim_sentence_ko: 망·조세·결제·데이터 결합·시장접근 규칙의 집행 가능성 차이가 국내 플랫폼에 구조적으로 더 큰 비용을 남김
evidence_summary: This is the strongest currently adoptable package: baseline and several robustness tests stay positive across music, webtoon/story, and digital infra, while sidecars such as tax-enforceability and bundle leverage enrich the Korean-market cost asymmetry reading without needing uniform direct proof in every row.
main_failure_or_risk: Tax-enforceability still relies partly on single-firm or bounded case evidence, webtoon/story remains thin, and headline-safe rows are still zero.

claim_sentence_ko: 국내 플랫폼은 생태계 인큐베이터 역할과 규제 순응 비용을 동시에 부담하는 반면 해외 플랫폼은 선택적 진입과 cherry-picking으로 상대적 이익을 얻음
evidence_summary: The signed rebuild and sidecar layer support the domestic-burden half of this story: domestic platforms visibly bear creator-side support and compliance costs, and the dynamic disadvantage mechanism is conceptually consistent with Korean-market platform asymmetry.
main_failure_or_risk: The foreign `selective entry / cherry-picking` half remains appendix- or conditional-only because current support is case- and counterfactual-heavy and lacks matched foreign burden evidence.
